sql: WITH "s1" AS (SELECT "budget"."link_to_event" AS e, AVG("budget"."remaining") AS m1, AVG((CAST(("budget"."spent" - "budget"."amount") AS REAL) / "budget"."amount")) AS m2 FROM "budget" GROUP BY "budget"."link_to_event"), "s2" AS (SELECT AVG("s1"."m2") AS v FROM "s1") SELECT "s1"."e" AS e, "s1"."m1" AS m1, "s1"."m2" AS m2, ("s1"."m2" - "s2"."v") AS m3 FROM "s1" JOIN "s2" ON "s2"."v" IS NOT NULL ORDER BY m3 DESC LIMIT 10

why: average of budget remaining (amount minus spent) per event (by link_to_event)
(amount spent in category - amount budgeted) / amount budgeted: the relative difference of two quantities in USD
